comments.author: Emma
comments.body:
CTC 5/5 has less total sails then LC 4/4. But it can have 1 more improve then LC, so you can get D sails, more ship parts in. So the top speed in general would be more or less the same or even better.
Also size of ship and the number of mast effects the acceleraton speed: LC with 5 masts, and bigger cargo apacity will take longer to get to top speed.
CTC can also as adjust cabin which is a nice skill too. Thumb up for CTC!

comments.author: Hernan
comments.body:
Just looking large clipper vs cruising tea clipper, no sails added, the CTC gives 45 more horizontal sails with a default FS build. If you make them both out of teak the CTC has 6 more vert and 53 more horizontal. The large clipper has 2 more masts however so it will be able to have larger vert and horizontal values once you fully equip them. The CTC will have an inate 3 turn advantage (assuming you use -1 turn sails) and 1 WR, which we all understand equates to faster speeds on open ocean.

I really feel like i'm missing something here on this particular ship and the merchant version because the level 64 versions seem to be just as good if not even a little bit better.

comments.author: Sophia
comments.body:
Better acceleration than a BTC, but everything I've been able to find says turn and WR don't actually matter for top speed. Using the formulas with wind of .625V+.825H crosswind .625(V+H) and vs wind .45V+.25H and assuming 22/25 sails and +11v equipment...

with wind: BTC 750, TC 733, CTC 732, CC 726, LMS 720
cross wind: LMS 643, BTC 636, CTC 618, TC 616, CC 614
vs wind: LMS 385, BTC 343, CC 331, CTC 330, TC 327

comments.author: Steward
comments.body: You haven't read enough, turn doesn't matter for top speed, but WR certainly does. Huge difference, I didn't even realize it was up for debate.

comments.author: Enver
comments.body: WR affects the bonus speed when crossing the different sea zones, and that % bonus is related to a max of the zone and the cargo the ship is transporting. WR gives less penalty from cargo, so the higer the WR, more bonus speed. 10% at coastal waters and 20-30% at deep sea is realy good

comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body: Sophia, top speed is affected by the ship capacity too, a Cruise Clipper is faster than BTC in most cases. While turn dont affect max speed, higher turn gives less speed reduction when turning... but most of the time these ships sail straight and mostly with EA on
